followup_reviews.Research finding: Actual cross-border freight stoppage on 21 December 2020 is supported and remains included; it is a distinct episode from later 2021/2022 strikes. Restrict the claim to Petrapole–Benapole goods exchange. Travellers and internal port operations were normal; no whole-border passenger closure is established. P1 retains exact 21 December onset/status, no endpoint, withheld_observation_only and zero complete flags. Bounded endpoint queries returned other episodes, not evidence of this strike’s resumption. Retain Policy and socioeconomic demands / Jobs, services and livelihoods for the reported facilities and working-condition demand. The other elements of the five-point programme were not recovered or invented. The decisive Daily Star body was freshly read. It quotes the customs officer and port actors; one article is not multiple independent news origins. The single phase remains unlocated with evidence-only display and no coordinates. The article’s place name does not justify invented marker geometry.
